initial.name: understand_image
initial.description: Ask a specific question about an original image already in this conversation. Copy the exact attachment identifier from the Image interpretation text, including its sha256: prefix. These images are stored in the Session, not as workspace files; do not search for guessed filenames.

attachment_id.description: Complete attachment identifier, including sha256: when present. Copy it verbatim from Image interpretation.

initial.name: read
initial.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

initial.name: read_image
initial.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file. A vision model interprets it for the current task when the current model cannot accept images.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

initial.name: write
initial.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

initial.name: edit
initial.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend.

old_string.description: Literal text to replace. Must match exactly.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.
